biggest_catch: No current or prior TruStone checking account — one old account disqualifies you — and the top $500 needs $5,000 in direct deposits within 60 days plus eStatements.
catches: You must have no current or prior TruStone checking account to qualify.
Tiered bonus within 60 days of opening: $200 for at least $1,000 in direct deposits, $300 at $2,500, $450 at $5,000 — plus $50 for enrolling in eStatements, for a maximum of $500.
Business and trust accounts are excluded; one bonus per account/membership.
Age 13+; account holders under 18 require a parent or guardian.

Account choices carry opening minimums and fees: TruRate Checking ($2,000 to open, $10 monthly fee waived with a $2,000 daily balance), Premium Checking ($300 to open, $5 monthly fee waived with a $300 daily balance), Value Checking ($25 to open, no monthly fee), MoneyWise ($5 to open).

steps: Confirm you have no current or prior TruStone checking account.

Open an eligible TruStone checking account between January 1 and December 31, 2026 — Value Checking ($25 to open, no monthly fee), Premium Checking ($300 to open), TruRate Checking ($2,000 to open), or MoneyWise ($5 to open).
Within 60 days of opening, receive direct deposits totaling at least $1,000 for $200, $2,500 for $300, or $5,000 for $450.
Enroll in eStatements for the additional $50.
Receive the bonus (up to $500) within 90 days of account opening.
